title: Search Engine & Query Injection
description: Query languages and search backends that may interpret untrusted input.

attacks.name: Elasticsearch injection
attacks.notes: Query DSL injection via user input
attacks.desc: Untrusted input embedded in Elasticsearch Query DSL can change the query logic or expose unintended documents.
attacks.prevention: Build Elasticsearch queries with typed server-side structures, not untrusted Query DSL fragments.

attacks.name: Lucene special chars
attacks.desc: Lucene operators can broaden or alter a search when user input is treated as query syntax.
attacks.prevention: Treat search text as literal input or explicitly escape Lucene operators before building a query.

attacks.name: Solr injection
attacks.desc: Solr parameters or administrative endpoints may accept input that changes queries or exposes configuration.

attacks.name: Mongo $where JS execution
attacks.desc: MongoDB's $where operator can execute JavaScript expressions if an application passes attacker-controlled values to it.

attacks.name: Aggregation pipeline injection
attacks.desc: Untrusted aggregation stages can change joins, filters, or document selection in a database query.

attacks.name: OpenSearch/Atlas injection
attacks.desc: Managed search or database services can still be vulnerable when applications construct queries from untrusted input.
